description: As a community you run, ASSIGN an approved event to a venue Space + slot (space_id + ISO start_time/end_time) — confirms the booking on the same conflict lock so it can never double-book. If the event already holds a Space here, REASSIGNS it: the old room is released and the new one claimed in one atomic motion (an overlapping slot in a different room is fine). A slot taken meanwhile aborts with the conflict named; idempotent on the same space+slot. Creator/admin/moderator. Requires community_id + event_id + space_id + times.
name: assign_event_to_space
title: Assign Event To Space
